resultScope: Each result is limited to its named predicate, exact source contract, supplied local input, and caller-declared intent.
Unsupported, missing, ambiguous, incomplete, or unobserved facts remain UNKNOWN.
The checks do not establish whole-upgrade compatibility, cluster state, effective configuration, runtime behavior, delivery, backup completion, or data safety.
The tool reads local data and does not execute supplied source, workloads, plugins, or commands.
There is no official prebuilt binary, hosted feed, startup refresh, or automatic knowledge admission.

knowledgeUpdates.metadataOnly: Reviewed metadata may reuse existing canonical facts and admitted input formats.
knowledgeUpdates.cliBoundary: New fact types, engine behavior, or native input formats may require a CLI release.
knowledgeUpdates.replay: Historical local selections remain explicit and separately verifiable.

contribution.policy: Candidate evidence receives independent source, semantic, and maintainer review before publication.
